milestone: V0.9 Product Runtime / Unified Goal API
progress: V0.9.1 Unified Goal API PASS; V0.9.2 Goal Query / Status / Events PASS; V0.9.3 Always-On ProductRuntime core and tests committed
execution_step: Run full regression CI for long-lived ProductRuntime core
execution_detail: ProductRuntime now composes UnifiedGoalService, GoalQueryService and one bounded RecoveryDaemon scan into a single long-lived product boundary. Clients can submit goals, query durable state, list goals, fetch incremental events, run one recovery tick, or enter a bounded polling loop. tick() performs exactly one scan and run() supports max_ticks / stop_when_idle so the runtime core remains testable and cannot accidentally become an uncontrollable busy loop. Transport/process hosting remains separate for later service adapters.
execution_result: V0.9.1 and V0.9.2 PASS; V0.9.3 validating...
current_work: Verify submit/query/events/tick/run semantics and historical compatibility across the full regression suite.
next_step: If CI is green, mark V0.9.3 DONE and begin V0.9.4 lifecycle controls: durable pause, cancel and explicit resume boundaries that fail closed and remain compatible with autonomous recovery.
finish_line: V0.9 completes when autonomous orchestration is exposed as a stable always-on product runtime with submission, query/status/events, lifecycle controls, and a real local service E2E.
user_action: None. Keep the V0.9 watcher open.
